description:
We are happy to announce that our 2021 Summer Reading Program has started here at the Mokena Library! We have programs for Children (Ages Infant - 5th Grade), Junior High (Ages 6th - 8th Grade), High School students and Adults. 

The theme for the Children's Summer Reading Program is "Reading Colors Your World!" To celebrate the kick off to Summer Read, and to go along with this year's colorful and fun theme, our Children's Librarian, Ms. Emily, will be reading "The Artist Who Painted a Blue Horse" by Eric Carle. This is cute book featuring lots of different animals and colors. 

To register for our Summer Reading Program, click on the link below using Beanstack. Once registered for this year's Summer Reading Program, you can pick up a registration bag with all of the goodies featured in this video, while supplies last. 
https://mokenalibrary.beanstack.org/reader365

To see all of the fun events and programs we have planned here at the Mokena Library, you can visit our events calendar on our website, or read our Summer Read Newsletter, both linked here. 
https://mokenalibrary.evanced.info/signup/Calendar
https://mokenalibrary.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/SINGLE-PAGE-SUMMER-READ-2021-Newsletter.pdf

description:
Join our Children’s Librarian, Ms. Emily, for a Virtual Story Time Monday, June 28th at 10:00am. Our Story Time theme is Pete the Cat and colors, crayons and rainbows. 🖍🌈 
We will be reading two stories. The first is “Pete the Cat Crayons Rock!” by Kimberly and James Dean. The second book is “Pete the Kitty and the Unicorn’s Missing Colors” by Kimberly and James Dean. 

The Children’s Summer Reading Program Beanstack Activity Badge Code is YSVSRP2. By unlocking the “Watch a Virtual Story Time video” Activity Badge, you will earn additional raffle tickets in Beanstack.
